latest.headline: GTI_1990 Breaks The Streak in Estonia
latest.paragraph: The WRC2 category saw a major shift in momentum at the Rally Estonia as GTI_1990 claimed their first victory of Season 5, successfully ending the undefeated run of StoryVS_TTV. Despite StoryVS_TTV setting the pace with five stage wins, a critical time penalty on stage five hampered their progress, relegating them to eighth place overall. GTI_1990 capitalized on this opportunity with three stage wins and consistent performance, finishing 31.030 seconds ahead of runner-up Janeman13. Speeedhunterr completed the podium, while mk6pinnock and Colesy3456 were forced to retire from the rally.
